plans.note: Separate caps for each side (9.1 IBM, 9.2 Customer). Check cap amount/formula for IBM, whether it is at least fees-paid-based, mutuality of the two caps, exclusion of consequential damages, and whether carve-outs (IP indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence/willful misconduct, payment obligations) survive the cap. Cross-check 5.4 Other Disclaimers for any additional damages exclusions and 14.14 Actions Period for a limitations-shortening term.

8.1 is the vendor-side indemnity — confirm it covers third-party IP infringement plus IBM's own misconduct, and that defense/settlement and remedy-on-injunction language is adequate. 8.2 is our indemnity: test that it stays narrow (our content/breach) and is not open-ended. sec-1 appears to be the indemnity procedure conditions (prompt notice, control); check notice is not a strict forfeiture. Confirm the IP indemnity is carved out of the 9.1 cap.

14.16 Freedom of Action likely preserves IBM's freedom rather than restricting us; scan it and 14.11 No Resale / 13.2 AUP for any restriction on the businesses we operate or competing products we may build or buy. Expect no true non-compete on Customer — mark missing/not-applicable if none found.
Check 14.16 and the services/charges sections for any sole-source or 'all requirements from IBM' language. Hosting agreements of this type usually leave us free to use other suppliers; likely absent.
Look in 4.1 Charges and 13.3 Amendments for any most-favoured-customer or best-terms language. Only flag if the obligation runs against us; an MFN in our favour is welcome and is not redlined.

14.8 Personnel is the most likely home for a hiring/solicitation restriction. Test direction (mutual vs. only on us), duration, whether it bars hiring as well as solicitation, and whether general advertising/unsolicited applicants are carved out.

3.4 is the core clause: confirm we may terminate on reasonable notice, quantify any termination charge/penalty, and check whether IBM has a mirror convenience right to exit mid-term (unacceptable). Cross-read 3.3 for cause triggers/cure periods and 3.5 for wind-down and refund of prepaid fees.

3.2 Renewal: check whether renewal is automatic, the length of the non-renewal notice window we must give, and whether renewal pricing is fixed or uplift-capped. Read with 3.1 Term and 4.1 Charges; notice mechanics in 14.20.

14.3 Choice of Law — confirm it names NY, DE, CA or England & Wales and whether venue/courts are specified (or any arbitration, especially foreign-seated). 14.4 jury waiver and 14.14 Actions Period (shortened limitations) are related but noted rather than double-flagged.

14.10: confirm we may assign to affiliates and to a successor by merger/asset sale without consent, that consent (where needed) is not unreasonably withheld, and that our change of control does not give IBM a termination right. Note IBM's own assignment/subcontracting rights for symmetry.

Ownership of Customer content/data and of any deliverables: 11.6 Content and Digital Certificates and 14.18 Data Protection for our data; 12.1 License and 14.17 Limitation of Licenses for what IBM grants and reserves. Confirm no assignment or broad licence-back of our IP/data to IBM beyond what is needed to deliver the services.

12.1 is the grant: test scope (affiliates and contractors as permitted users), whether it is revocable at will or terminable only with the agreement, and any restrictions in 14.17 Limitation of Licenses and 14.11 No Resale. 12.2 covers maintenance of Base Components.

11.3 Suspected Violations is the likely audit/inspection or access-suspension hook, read with 13.2 AUP. Test for advance notice, frequency limits, business-hours/off-site conduct, confidentiality, and who bears cost; also check whether IBM can suspend or investigate unilaterally.

Scan 4.2 Payment for late-payment interest/charges and 3.5 for early-termination charges that function as liquidated damages against us. Service credits running to us are welcome and not flagged. Likely no true LD clause.

5.1 IBM's warranties — check for a workmanlike-performance/conformity warranty, its duration, and the stated remedy (re-performance vs. sole remedy of refund). 5.2 Exclusivity of Warranties and 5.4 Other Disclaimers likely disclaim implied warranties; 11.2 sets our reciprocal reps. Confirm the remedy is real and not illusory.

No insurance heading in the outline; check 5.3 Security, 14.12 Risk of Loss and 14.18 Data Protection for any incidental coverage requirement. If none, treat as missing and request standard commercial/cyber/E&O coverage given IBM hosts our data.

4.1 Charges plus Order Forms/Service Option Attachments may embed committed volumes, minimum monthly charges or capacity commitments (see 11.5 Capacity Planning). Test whether any minimum is take-or-pay and whether the 3.4 convenience exit relieves it.

3.5 Effect of Termination is the place to confirm return/deletion of our content and data, a defined retrieval window, and any migration assistance and its pricing. If it only addresses fee acceleration and access cut-off, treat transition assistance/data return as missing; 14.2 Survival should carry the obligation.
